skills.name: ultra-text
skills.description: Add Ultra-white HDR letterforms to headlines and logotypes using a WebGPU canvas. Text stays real, selectable, and copyable. Works with any coding agent that supports the skills convention.

skills.name: gainmap-convert
skills.description: Convert photos to HDR gain map images (ISO 21496-1 Ultra HDR JPEG) locally in a browser service worker. Accepts JPEG, PNG, HEIC, WebP, or AVIF input.

skills.name: gainmap-cli
skills.description: Batch-encode HDR gain map images from the terminal using the gainmap CLI. Install via npm, Homebrew, or curl.
